biography.value: Tar, rope and shouting. Passage bought at the quayside, and for those with far more money than sense, a hull of their own.

description.value: A narrow raiding vessel, oared and sailed.
A small open boat for two to four passengers.

Potion, Uncommon

You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.

This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

Foundry Note

The Water Breather Active Effect can be used for tracking.

affects.special: One creature or object of your choice in the Line

description.value:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds.

You can take a Magic action to remove the stopper and issue one of three command words, whereupon an amount of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgspWaterfresh0]{fresh water} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgspWatersalt00]{salt water} (your choice) pours out of the flask. The water stops pouring out at the start of your next turn. Choose from the following command words:

Splash. The decanter produces 1 gallon of water.

Fountain. The decanter produces 5 gallons of water.

Geyser. The decanter produces 30 gallons of water that gushes forth in a Line 30 feet long and 1 foot wide. If you're holding the decanter, you can aim the geyser in one direction (no action required). One creature of your choice in the Line must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 1d4 Bludgeoning damage and have the &Reference[Prone] condition. Instead of a creature, you can target one object in the Line that isn't being worn or carried and that weighs no more than 200 pounds. The object is knocked over by the geyser.

Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition.

Ring, Uncommon

You have a Swim Speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.

Ring, Uncommon

While wearing this ring, you cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWaterWalk0]{Water Walk} from it, targeting only yourself.

Wondrous Item, Uncommon, See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgQuaalsFeather]{Feather Token}

You can take a Magic action to touch the token to a boat or ship. For the next 24 hours, the vessel can't be moved by any means. Touching the token to the vessel again ends the effect. When the effect ends, the token disappears.

Wondrous Item, Uncommon, See: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.dmgQuaalsFeather]{Feather Token}

If you are on a boat or ship, you can take a Magic action to toss the token up to 10 feet in the air. The token disappears, and a giant flapping fan takes its place. The fan floats and creates a strong wind. This wind can fill the sails of one ship, increasing its speed by 5 miles per hour for 8 hours. You can dismiss the fan as a Magic action.

effects.name: Feather Token: Fan
effects.description: This wind can fill the sails of one ship, increasing its speed by 5 miles per hour for 8 hours. You can dismiss the fan as a Magic action.

description.value:
Wondrous Item, Uncommon

While holding this fan, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{Gust of Wind} (save DC 13) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.

Roll for Chance of Not Working: [[/r 1d5cs>@item.uses.spent]]

Foundry Note

Each of use of Gust of Wind expends a use of this item and is reset at dawn. The inline roll above rolls 1d5 and checks if the value is higher than the number of uses to handle the cumulative 20 percent chance of not working. It will return "1" if it's successful and "0" if it fails.

Weapon (@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepTrident000]{Trident}), Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

This magic weapon has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you carry it, you can expend 1 charge to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDominateBe]{Dominate Beast} (save DC 15) from it on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.

Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement)

While wearing this cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.
